function: Excluded, no_learning: sparse Bayesian learning channel estimator solved by an iterative EM algorithm per received pilot frame, with no trained model (p. 11, Algorithm 1).
notes: Excluded as no_learning. The title says 'Learning-Based Channel Estimator' (p. 1), but ConvBL is a sparse Bayesian learning algorithm. Algorithm 1 (p. 11) repeats an E step (posterior mean and covariance, Eq. 27, p. 10) and an M step (natural-gradient and AdaGrad update of the prior variances, Eqs. 35-36, p. 11) on each received pilot frame until the loss change is below a threshold, at each AP independently. Nothing is trained offline: the text has no neural network, no training set, and no parameters learned on data and reused across frames. The compared methods SBL, CPSBL, OMP, and the CRLB are also model-based sparse recovery or bounds (p. 14). The only channel statistics taken from 3GPP is the path loss (p. 14, Eq. 51). If the reviewer counts Bayesian learning as a learned component, the area would be 4 (OTFS channel estimation).
